name.title: Business name
name.description: The business or place name exactly as shown on Google Maps. Always present for a valid result.

address.title: Full address
address.description: Street address including city, state, and postal code, as returned by Google Maps. May be null for businesses that hide their address.
address.example: 221 W N Loop Blvd, Austin, TX 78751, United States

rating.title: Star rating
rating.description: Google star rating from 1.0 to 5.0, or null for businesses with too few reviews to have a rating.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.description: Public phone number in international format. Around 60 to 100 percent of results include one depending on the business type. Use it for cold calling or SMS outreach.

website.title: Website URL
website.description: The official website URL for the business. Present on nearly every result and is the best field for email finding, domain enrichment, and competitor research.

overview.title: Leads
overview.description: One row per business with name, address, rating, phone, and website.
